items.question: Trong câu "An API outlives the code behind it: once clients ship, every field, status code and error shape is a promise.", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An API outlives the code behind it: once clients ship, every field, status code and error shape is a promise.", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. "X outlives Y" = X còn tồn tại sau khi Y đã mất; API sống lâu hơn cả phần code phía sau nó.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. "X outlives Y" means X is still around after Y is gone; an API lasts longer than the code behind it.

items.question: Trong câu "The first decision is the style, because it fixes transport, tooling and failure modes.", từ "fix" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first decision is the style, because it fixes transport, tooling and failure modes.", what does "fix" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fix /fɪks/ (động từ): xác định, ấn định. Ngoài nghĩa "sửa lỗi", fix còn là "ấn định": chọn kiểu API sẽ ấn định luôn giao thức và công cụ.
items.explanationEn: fix /fɪks/ (verb): to decide, to set firmly. Besides "repair", fix also means "to set or determine": choosing the style determines transport and tooling.

items.question: Trong câu "The first decision is the style, because it fixes transport, tooling and failure modes.", từ "transport" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first decision is the style, because it fixes transport, tooling and failure modes.", what does "transport" (noun) mean?
options: cơ chế truyền tải dữ liệu
items.explanation: transport /ˈtræn.spɔːt/ (danh từ): cơ chế truyền tải dữ liệu. Trong mạng máy tính, transport là tầng/cơ chế mang dữ liệu đi, ví dụ HTTP/2 hay WebSocket.
items.explanationEn: transport /ˈtræn.spɔːt/ (noun): the way data is carried. In networking, transport is the layer or mechanism that carries data, such as HTTP/2 or WebSocket.

items.question: Trong câu "A defensible default: REST at the public edge, gRPC between services, events for work that can wait (brokers are covered in the messaging topic).", từ "defensible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A defensible default: REST at the public edge, gRPC between services, events for work that can wait (brokers are covered in the messaging topic).", what does "defensible" (adjective) mean?
options: có thể bảo vệ được (lập luận)
items.explanation: defensible /dɪˈfen.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể bảo vệ được (lập luận). "A defensible choice" = lựa chọn có lý do vững chắc, dễ bảo vệ khi bị chất vấn trong phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: defensible /dɪˈfen.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be justified. "A defensible choice" is one you can justify with solid reasons when challenged, e.g. in an interview.

items.question: Trong câu "A defensible default: REST at the public edge, gRPC between services, events for work that can wait (brokers are covered in the messaging topic).", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A defensible default: REST at the public edge, gRPC between services, events for work that can wait (brokers are covered in the messaging topic).", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the sharp side of a blade
the outer boundary of a system
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): rìa, biên (của hệ thống). "At the edge" = ở biên ngoài cùng, nơi client bên ngoài gọi vào; khác với "edge" trong đồ thị.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): the outer boundary of a system. "At the edge" means at the outer boundary where external clients connect; unlike an "edge" in a graph.

items.question: Trong câu "Write the contract first — OpenAPI, .proto or GraphQL SDL — and generate clients, mocks and docs from it.", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write the contract first — OpenAPI, .proto or GraphQL SDL — and generate clients, mocks and docs from it.", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): sinh ra, tạo tự động. "Generate code from a spec" = sinh code tự động từ bản đặc tả như OpenAPI.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to produce automatically. "Generate code from a spec" means producing code automatically from a specification such as OpenAPI.

items.question: Trong câu "Use plural nouns, opaque IDs (auto-increment integers leak volume and invite enumeration), ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and money as integer minor units plus currency — never floats.", từ "opaque" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use plural nouns, opaque IDs (auto-increment integers leak volume and invite enumeration), ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and money as integer minor units plus currency — never floats.", what does "opaque" (adjective) mean?
options: không để lộ cấu trúc bên trong
được sắp xếp theo thứ tự
items.explanation: opaque /əʊˈpeɪk/ (tính từ): không để lộ cấu trúc bên trong. "Opaque ID" = mã định danh mà client không suy ra được ý nghĩa hay thứ tự; nghĩa gốc là "mờ, không trong suốt".
items.explanationEn: opaque /əʊˈpeɪk/ (adjective): not revealing its internal structure. An "opaque ID" is one whose meaning or order clients cannot infer; the literal sense is "not see-through".

items.question: Trong câu "Use plural nouns, opaque IDs (auto-increment integers leak volume and invite enumeration), ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and money as integer minor units plus currency — never floats.", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use plural nouns, opaque IDs (auto-increment integers leak volume and invite enumeration), ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and money as integer minor units plus currency — never floats.", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): làm lộ (thông tin). "Leak data / leak volume" = vô tình để lộ thông tin; ID tăng dần làm lộ số lượng đơn hàng.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to reveal information. "Leak data" means revealing information by accident; auto-increment IDs reveal how many orders exist.

items.question: Trong câu "Use plural nouns, opaque IDs (auto-increment integers leak volume and invite enumeration), ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and money as integer minor units plus currency — never floats.", từ "enumeration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use plural nouns, opaque IDs (auto-increment integers leak volume and invite enumeration), ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and money as integer minor units plus currency — never floats.", what does "enumeration" (noun) mean?
options: việc dò lần lượt từng mục
items.explanation: enumeration /ɪˌnjuː.məˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc dò lần lượt từng mục. "Enumeration attack" = kẻ tấn công thử lần lượt ID 1, 2, 3… để dò tài nguyên. Động từ: enumerate.
items.explanationEn: enumeration /ɪˌnjuː.məˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): trying items one by one. An "enumeration attack" tries IDs 1, 2, 3… in turn to discover resources. Verb: enumerate.

items.question: Trong câu "Retries, proxies and caches rely on method semantics:", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retries, proxies and caches rely on method semantics:", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào. "Rely on something" = tin cậy và phụ thuộc vào điều gì; retry, proxy và cache đều dựa vào ngữ nghĩa của method.
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Rely on something" means to depend on it; retries, proxies and caches depend on method semantics.

items.question: Trong câu "Retries, proxies and caches rely on method semantics:", từ "semantics" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retries, proxies and caches rely on method semantics:", what does "semantics" (noun) mean?
options: ngữ nghĩa, ý nghĩa quy ước
items.explanation: semantics /sɪˈmæn.tɪks/ (danh từ): ngữ nghĩa, ý nghĩa quy ước. Semantics là ý nghĩa/hành vi được cam kết, khác với syntax (cú pháp). "Method semantics" = GET an toàn, PUT idempotent…
items.explanationEn: semantics /sɪˈmæn.tɪks/ (noun): the agreed meaning of something. Semantics is the promised meaning or behaviour, as opposed to syntax. "Method semantics": GET is safe, PUT is idempotent…

items.question: Trong câu "Optimistic concurrency: return an ETag; the client sends If-Match on update; if the resource changed meanwhile, answer 412 Precondition Failed instead of silently overwriting (lost update).", từ "optimistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Optimistic concurrency: return an ETag; the client sends If-Match on update; if the resource changed meanwhile, answer 412 Precondition Failed instead of silently overwriting (lost update).", what does "optimistic" (adjective) mean?
options: lạc quan (giả định ít xung đột)
items.explanation: optimistic /ˌɒp.tɪˈmɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): lạc quan (giả định ít xung đột). "Optimistic concurrency" = không khóa trước, chỉ kiểm tra xung đột khi ghi; đối lập với pessimistic locking.
items.explanationEn: optimistic /ˌɒp.tɪˈmɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): assuming conflicts are rare. "Optimistic concurrency" takes no lock up front and checks for conflicts at write time; the opposite is pessimistic locking.

items.question: Trong câu "Optimistic concurrency: return an ETag; the client sends If-Match on update; if the resource changed meanwhile, answer 412 Precondition Failed instead of silently overwriting (lost update).", từ "meanwhile" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Optimistic concurrency: return an ETag; the client sends If-Match on update; if the resource changed meanwhile, answer 412 Precondition Failed instead of silently overwriting (lost update).", what does "meanwhile" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: meanwhile /ˈmiːn.waɪl/ (trạng từ): trong lúc đó. "Changed meanwhile" = đã bị thay đổi trong khoảng thời gian client đang xử lý.
items.explanationEn: meanwhile /ˈmiːn.waɪl/ (adverb): during that time. "Changed meanwhile" means modified during the time the client was working on it.

items.question: Trong câu "Optimistic concurrency: return an ETag; the client sends If-Match on update; if the resource changed meanwhile, answer 412 Precondition Failed instead of silently overwriting (lost update).", từ "overwrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Optimistic concurrency: return an ETag; the client sends If-Match on update; if the resource changed meanwhile, answer 412 Precondition Failed instead of silently overwriting (lost update).", what does "overwrite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè lên. "Silently overwrite" = ghi đè dữ liệu mà không báo lỗi, gây ra "lost update".
items.explanationEn: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (verb): to replace existing data. "Silently overwrite" means replacing data without any error, which causes a lost update.

items.question: Trong câu "Gateways, retry logic and dashboards branch on status codes.", từ "branch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gateways, retry logic and dashboards branch on status codes.", what does "branch" (verb) mean?
options: rẽ nhánh (xử lý theo điều kiện)
optionsEn: to take different paths by condition
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (động từ): rẽ nhánh (xử lý theo điều kiện). "Branch on X" = chọn hướng xử lý khác nhau tùy theo giá trị X; danh từ branch còn là "nhánh git", "chi nhánh".
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (verb): to take different paths by condition. "Branch on X" means choosing different logic depending on X; the noun also means a git branch or an office.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: 4xx = client must change something, don't blindly retry; 5xx and 429 = retry with backoff.", từ "blindly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: 4xx = client must change something, don't blindly retry; 5xx and 429 = retry with backoff.", what does "blindly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: blindly /ˈblaɪnd.li/ (trạng từ): một cách mù quáng. "Blindly retry" = thử lại mà không xét nguyên nhân lỗi; lỗi 4xx thử lại cũng vô ích.
items.explanationEn: blindly /ˈblaɪnd.li/ (adverb): without thinking. "Blindly retry" means retrying without considering why it failed; retrying a 4xx is pointless.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: 4xx = client must change something, don't blindly retry; 5xx and 429 = retry with backoff.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: 4xx = client must change something, don't blindly retry; 5xx and 429 = retry with backoff.", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): nguyên tắc kinh nghiệm. "As a rule of thumb" = theo kinh nghiệm chung, đúng trong đa số trường hợp chứ không tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. "As a rule of thumb" means a guideline from experience that holds most of the time, not always.

items.question: Trong câu "The client therefore sends a UUID idempotency key per logical operation, identical on every retry.", từ "therefore" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The client therefore sends a UUID idempotency key per logical operation, identical on every retry.", what does "therefore" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: therefore /ˈðeə.fɔːr/ (trạng từ): vì vậy, do đó. Therefore nối kết quả với nguyên nhân phía trước: vì mạng có thể lỗi, nên client gửi idempotency key.
items.explanationEn: therefore /ˈðeə.fɔːr/ (adverb): for that reason. Therefore links a result to the preceding cause: because networks fail, the client sends a key.

items.question: Trong câu "The client therefore sends a UUID idempotency key per logical operation, identical on every retry.", từ "identical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The client therefore sends a UUID idempotency key per logical operation, identical on every retry.", what does "identical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giống hệt nhau. "Identical to/on" = y hệt; key phải giống hệt ở mọi lần retry thì server mới nhận ra là cùng một thao tác.
items.explanationEn: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): exactly the same. "Identical" means exactly the same; the key must match on every retry so the server sees one operation.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope keys per account; store key, request hash and response with a TTL (Stripe keeps them about 24 hours).", từ "scope" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope keys per account; store key, request hash and response with a TTL (Stripe keeps them about 24 hours).", what does "scope" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (động từ): giới hạn phạm vi. "Scope X per account" = giới hạn X trong phạm vi từng tài khoản; danh từ scope = phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (verb): to limit the range of. "Scope X per account" means limiting X to each account; the noun scope means range or extent.

items.question: Trong câu "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", từ "reserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", what does "reserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ chỗ trước. "Reserve a key" = chiếm giữ key trước khi xử lý để request khác không dùng được; đừng nhầm với reverse.
items.explanationEn: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to claim in advance. "Reserve a key" means claiming it before processing so no other request can take it; not "reverse".

items.question: Trong câu "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", từ "atomically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", what does "atomically" (adverb) mean?
options: như một thao tác không thể chia cắt
ở mức nguyên tử vật lý
items.explanation: atomically /əˈtɒm.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): như một thao tác không thể chia cắt. "Atomically" = hoặc thành công trọn vẹn hoặc không xảy ra, không có trạng thái nửa vời xen giữa.
items.explanationEn: atomically /əˈtɒm.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): as one indivisible step. "Atomically" means all-or-nothing, with no half-finished state other requests can observe.

items.question: Trong câu "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc. "Unique constraint" = ràng buộc duy nhất trong CSDL, chặn hai bản ghi trùng giá trị.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a restricting rule. A "unique constraint" is a database rule that blocks two rows with the same value.

items.question: Trong câu "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserve atomically (unique constraint or Redis SET key val NX EX ttl) so concurrent retries cannot both run.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời, chạy song song. "Concurrent retries" = các lần thử lại đến cùng lúc; danh từ: concurrency.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Concurrent retries" are retries arriving at the same time; noun: concurrency.

items.question: Trong câu "PUT and DELETE are idempotent by definition; keys are for POST.", từ "by definition" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PUT and DELETE are idempotent by definition; keys are for POST.", what does "by definition" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by definition /baɪ ˌdef.ɪˈnɪʃ.ən/ (cụm từ): theo định nghĩa. "By definition" = bản chất của nó đã như vậy; khác "by default" (theo mặc định, có thể đổi).
items.explanationEn: by definition /baɪ ˌdef.ɪˈnɪʃ.ən/ (phrase): because of what it means. "By definition" means true because of what the thing is; unlike "by default", which can be changed.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumers downstream still deduplicate on their own.", từ "downstream" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumers downstream still deduplicate on their own.", what does "downstream" (adverb) mean?
options: ở phía sau trong luồng xử lý
items.explanation: downstream /ˌdaʊnˈstriːm/ (trạng từ): ở phía sau trong luồng xử lý. "Downstream" = các thành phần nhận dữ liệu sau; ngược lại là upstream (phía cung cấp).
items.explanationEn: downstream /ˌdaʊnˈstriːm/ (adverb): later in the processing flow. "Downstream" means components that receive data later; the opposite is upstream.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumers downstream still deduplicate on their own.", từ "deduplicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumers downstream still deduplicate on their own.", what does "deduplicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deduplicate /diːˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ bản trùng lặp. Deduplicate (viết tắt "dedupe") = lọc bỏ các message/bản ghi bị lặp; danh từ: deduplication.
items.explanationEn: deduplicate /diːˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to remove duplicate copies. Deduplicate ("dedupe") means filtering out repeated messages or records; noun: deduplication.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumers downstream still deduplicate on their own.", từ "on their own" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumers downstream still deduplicate on their own.", what does "on their own" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on their own /ɒn ðeər ˈəʊn/ (cụm từ): tự mình, độc lập. "On one's own" = tự làm, không dựa vào ai; consumer vẫn phải tự khử trùng lặp.
items.explanationEn: on their own /ɒn ðeər ˈəʊn/ (phrase): by themselves. "On one's own" means without help; consumers must still deduplicate by themselves.

items.question: Trong câu "Never return an unbounded list.", từ "unbounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never return an unbounded list.", what does "unbounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unbounded /ʌnˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): không có giới hạn. "Unbounded list" = danh sách có thể dài vô hạn; bound = giới hạn, cận.
items.explanationEn: unbounded /ʌnˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): having no limit. An "unbounded list" can grow without limit; a bound is a limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Make cursors opaque (base64 of the sort key) so internals can change, and always include a unique tiebreaker (id) or rows with equal timestamps vanish.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make cursors opaque (base64 of the sort key) so internals can change, and always include a unique tiebreaker (id) or rows with equal timestamps vanish.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Rows vanish" = các dòng biến mất khỏi kết quả phân trang vì thiếu khóa phá hòa (tiebreaker).
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. "Rows vanish" means rows silently disappear from paginated results when there is no tiebreaker.

items.question: Trong câu "Cap limit server-side; avoid exact totals on big tables", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cap limit server-side; avoid exact totals on big tables", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): đặt mức trần, giới hạn. "Cap X at N" = không cho X vượt quá N; danh từ cap cũng là "mức trần" hoặc "cái nắp".
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit. "Cap X at N" means not letting X exceed N; the noun cap also means a ceiling or a lid.

items.question: Trong câu "Additive changes (new optional fields, new endpoints) are safe if clients are tolerant readers that ignore unknown fields.", từ "additive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Additive changes (new optional fields, new endpoints) are safe if clients are tolerant readers that ignore unknown fields.", what does "additive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: additive /ˈæd.ɪ.tɪv/ (tính từ): chỉ thêm vào, không bớt. "Additive change" = thay đổi chỉ bổ sung trường/endpoint mới, không phá client cũ.
items.explanationEn: additive /ˈæd.ɪ.tɪv/ (adjective): only adding, not removing. An "additive change" only adds new fields or endpoints and does not break existing clients.

items.question: Trong câu "Additive changes (new optional fields, new endpoints) are safe if clients are tolerant readers that ignore unknown fields.", từ "tolerant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Additive changes (new optional fields, new endpoints) are safe if clients are tolerant readers that ignore unknown fields.", what does "tolerant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tolerant /ˈtɒl.ər.ənt/ (tính từ): chấp nhận được sai khác. "Tolerant reader" = client bỏ qua trường lạ thay vì báo lỗi; liên quan: fault-tolerant (chịu lỗi).
items.explanationEn: tolerant /ˈtɒl.ər.ənt/ (adjective): accepting of differences. A "tolerant reader" ignores unknown fields instead of failing; related: fault-tolerant.

items.question: Trong câu "Retiring a version is a process: announce, measure remaining callers per client at the gateway, send a Sunset header (RFC 8594) with the date, brown-out, then switch off.", từ "retire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retiring a version is a process: announce, measure remaining callers per client at the gateway, send a Sunset header (RFC 8594) with the date, brown-out, then switch off.", what does "retire" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop working due to age
items.explanation: retire /rɪˈtaɪər/ (động từ): ngừng sử dụng dần. "Retire a version/system" = cho ngừng hoạt động theo kế hoạch; nghĩa thường ngày là "nghỉ hưu".
items.explanationEn: retire /rɪˈtaɪər/ (verb): to phase out of use. "Retire a version" means taking it out of service in a planned way; the everyday sense is to stop working due to age.

items.question: Trong câu "Retiring a version is a process: announce, measure remaining callers per client at the gateway, send a Sunset header (RFC 8594) with the date, brown-out, then switch off.", từ "switch off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retiring a version is a process: announce, measure remaining callers per client at the gateway, send a Sunset header (RFC 8594) with the date, brown-out, then switch off.", what does "switch off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: switch off /ˌswɪtʃ ˈɒf/ (cụm từ): tắt hẳn. "Switch off" = tắt; bước cuối cùng khi khai tử một phiên bản API.
items.explanationEn: switch off /ˌswɪtʃ ˈɒf/ (phrase): to turn off. "Switch off" means to turn off; it is the last step when retiring an API version.

items.question: Trong câu "gRPC runs on HTTP/2 with Protobuf as contract and binary encoding; typed clients and servers are generated from .proto.", từ "binary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gRPC runs on HTTP/2 with Protobuf as contract and binary encoding; typed clients and servers are generated from .proto.", what does "binary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: binary /ˈbaɪ.nər.i/ (tính từ): dạng nhị phân. "Binary encoding" = dữ liệu mã hóa thành byte, gọn hơn JSON dạng text; "binary choice" lại là lựa chọn hai phương án.
items.explanationEn: binary /ˈbaɪ.nər.i/ (adjective): in machine-readable bytes. "Binary encoding" stores data as compact bytes rather than text; a "binary choice" means two options.

items.question: Trong câu "gRPC runs on HTTP/2 with Protobuf as contract and binary encoding; typed clients and servers are generated from .proto.", từ "encoding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gRPC runs on HTTP/2 with Protobuf as contract and binary encoding; typed clients and servers are generated from .proto.", what does "encoding" (noun) mean?
options: cách mã hóa biểu diễn dữ liệu
items.explanation: encoding /ɪnˈkəʊ.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách mã hóa biểu diễn dữ liệu. Encoding là cách biểu diễn dữ liệu (UTF-8, base64, Protobuf), không nhằm giữ bí mật như encryption.
items.explanationEn: encoding /ɪnˈkəʊ.dɪŋ/ (noun): a format for representing data. Encoding is how data is represented (UTF-8, base64, Protobuf); unlike encryption, it does not hide data.

items.question: Trong câu "Four call types: unary, server streaming, client streaming, bidirectional.", từ "bidirectional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four call types: unary, server streaming, client streaming, bidirectional.", what does "bidirectional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bidirectional /ˌbaɪ.daɪˈrek.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): hai chiều. "Bidirectional streaming" = cả client và server cùng gửi luồng dữ liệu cho nhau; bi- = hai.
items.explanationEn: bidirectional /ˌbaɪ.daɪˈrek.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): in both directions. "Bidirectional streaming" means client and server both stream data; the prefix bi- means two.

items.question: Trong câu "Set deadlines; they propagate across hops and expire as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.", từ "propagate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set deadlines; they propagate across hops and expire as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.", what does "propagate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propagate /ˈprɒp.ə.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): lan truyền, truyền tiếp. "Deadlines propagate" = thời hạn được truyền tiếp qua từng service trong chuỗi gọi.
items.explanationEn: propagate /ˈprɒp.ə.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to pass along to others. "Deadlines propagate" means the deadline is passed on to each service along the call chain.

items.question: Trong câu "Set deadlines; they propagate across hops and expire as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.", từ "hop" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set deadlines; they propagate across hops and expire as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.", what does "hop" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hop /hɒp/ (danh từ): một chặng chuyển tiếp mạng. "Hop" = một bước đi qua một nút mạng/service; "multi-hop" = qua nhiều chặng.
items.explanationEn: hop /hɒp/ (noun): one step between network nodes. A "hop" is one step through a network node or service; "multi-hop" means many steps.

items.question: Trong câu "Set deadlines; they propagate across hops and expire as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set deadlines; they propagate across hops and expire as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪər/ (động từ): hết hạn. "Token/deadline expires" = hết hiệu lực khi quá thời hạn; danh từ: expiry, expiration.
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪər/ (verb): to reach its time limit. "A token expires" means it stops being valid after its time limit; nouns: expiry, expiration.

items.question: Trong câu "Default max received message is 4 MB in most implementations — stream big payloads.", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Default max received message is 4 MB in most implementations — stream big payloads.", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): bản hiện thực (thư viện, mã). "Most implementations" = đa số thư viện/bản cài đặt cụ thể của một đặc tả như gRPC.
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a concrete working version. "Most implementations" means most concrete libraries that realise a specification such as gRPC.

items.question: Trong câu "Default max received message is 4 MB in most implementations — stream big payloads.", từ "payload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Default max received message is 4 MB in most implementations — stream big payloads.", what does "payload" (noun) mean?
options: phần dữ liệu chính được gửi
items.explanation: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (danh từ): phần dữ liệu chính được gửi. "Big payloads" = phần thân dữ liệu lớn; phân biệt với header và metadata.
items.explanationEn: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (noun): the main data being sent. "Big payloads" are large bodies of data, as opposed to headers and metadata.

items.question: Trong câu "Gotchas: HTTP/2 multiplexes calls over one long-lived connection, so an L4 load balancer pins everything to one backend — use an L7 proxy (Envoy, ALB) or client-side balancing.", từ "multiplex" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gotchas: HTTP/2 multiplexes calls over one long-lived connection, so an L4 load balancer pins everything to one backend — use an L7 proxy (Envoy, ALB) or client-side balancing.", what does "multiplex" (verb) mean?
options: ghép nhiều luồng trên một kênh
optionsEn: to share one channel among many streams
items.explanation: multiplex /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pleks/ (động từ): ghép nhiều luồng trên một kênh. HTTP/2 "multiplexes" nhiều request trên một kết nối TCP duy nhất thay vì mở nhiều kết nối.
items.explanationEn: multiplex /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pleks/ (verb): to share one channel among many streams. HTTP/2 multiplexes many requests over a single TCP connection instead of opening many.

items.question: Trong câu "Gotchas: HTTP/2 multiplexes calls over one long-lived connection, so an L4 load balancer pins everything to one backend — use an L7 proxy (Envoy, ALB) or client-side balancing.", từ "pin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gotchas: HTTP/2 multiplexes calls over one long-lived connection, so an L4 load balancer pins everything to one backend — use an L7 proxy (Envoy, ALB) or client-side balancing.", what does "pin" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pin /pɪn/ (động từ): gắn cố định vào. "Pin X to Y" = cố định X vào Y; bộ cân bằng L4 gắn mọi call vào một backend duy nhất.
items.explanationEn: pin /pɪn/ (verb): to fix to one target. "Pin X to Y" means fixing X to Y; an L4 balancer sends every call to a single backend.

items.question: Trong câu "Browsers cannot speak raw gRPC: use gRPC-Web through a proxy or transcode to REST at the gateway.", từ "raw" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Browsers cannot speak raw gRPC: use gRPC-Web through a proxy or transcode to REST at the gateway.", what does "raw" (adjective) mean?
options: nguyên bản, chưa qua xử lý
items.explanation: raw /rɔː/ (tính từ): nguyên bản, chưa qua xử lý. "Raw gRPC" = gRPC gốc chưa qua lớp chuyển đổi; "raw data" = dữ liệu thô.
items.explanationEn: raw /rɔː/ (adjective): unprocessed, in original form. "Raw gRPC" is gRPC with no translation layer; "raw data" is unprocessed data.

items.question: Trong câu "One endpoint, a typed schema, and the client selects exactly the fields it needs — no over-fetching, one round trip per screen.", từ "round trip" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One endpoint, a typed schema, and the client selects exactly the fields it needs — no over-fetching, one round trip per screen.", what does "round trip" (phrase) mean?
options: một lượt gửi và nhận phản hồi
items.explanation: round trip /ˌraʊnd ˈtrɪp/ (cụm từ): một lượt gửi và nhận phản hồi. "One round trip" = chỉ một lần đi và về giữa client và server, giảm độ trễ.
items.explanationEn: round trip /ˌraʊnd ˈtrɪp/ (phrase): one request and its response. "One round trip" means a single request-response exchange, which reduces latency.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose GraphQL when many clients need different views of a rich domain (often as a BFF); for CRUD or service-to-service, REST or gRPC is cheaper to run.", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose GraphQL when many clients need different views of a rich domain (often as a BFF); for CRUD or service-to-service, REST or gRPC is cheaper to run.", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): lĩnh vực nghiệp vụ. "Rich domain" = lĩnh vực nghiệp vụ có nhiều thực thể và quan hệ; cũng dùng trong "domain-driven design".
items.explanationEn: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (noun): a business subject area. A "rich domain" is a business area with many entities and relations, as in "domain-driven design".

items.question: Trong câu "Scaling is the hard part: a message for user A must reach the node holding A's socket, so add a pub/sub backplane (Redis, NATS), heartbeats under the load balancer idle timeout, and jittered reconnects to avoid storms after deploys.", từ "idle" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scaling is the hard part: a message for user A must reach the node holding A's socket, so add a pub/sub backplane (Redis, NATS), heartbeats under the load balancer idle timeout, and jittered reconnects to avoid storms after deploys.", what does "idle" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: idle /ˈaɪ.dəl/ (tính từ): không hoạt động, nhàn rỗi. "Idle timeout" = thời gian tối đa kết nối được phép im lặng trước khi bị cắt.
items.explanationEn: idle /ˈaɪ.dəl/ (adjective): not active. An "idle timeout" is how long a connection may stay silent before it is closed.

items.question: Trong câu "Scaling is the hard part: a message for user A must reach the node holding A's socket, so add a pub/sub backplane (Redis, NATS), heartbeats under the load balancer idle timeout, and jittered reconnects to avoid storms after deploys.", từ "storm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scaling is the hard part: a message for user A must reach the node holding A's socket, so add a pub/sub backplane (Redis, NATS), heartbeats under the load balancer idle timeout, and jittered reconnects to avoid storms after deploys.", what does "storm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: storm /stɔːm/ (danh từ): đợt dồn dập (request). "Reconnect storm" = hàng loạt client kết nối lại cùng lúc làm quá tải server; nghĩa gốc là "cơn bão".
items.explanationEn: storm /stɔːm/ (noun): a sudden flood of requests. A "reconnect storm" is many clients reconnecting at once and overloading servers; literally violent weather.

items.question: Trong câu "The single entry point that applies cross-cutting concerns so services don't each reimplement them.", từ "concern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The single entry point that applies cross-cutting concerns so services don't each reimplement them.", what does "concern" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (danh từ): khía cạnh cần xử lý. "Separation of concerns" = tách các khía cạnh; "cross-cutting concerns" = khía cạnh dùng chung như auth, logging.
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (noun): an aspect to handle. "Separation of concerns" splits aspects apart; "cross-cutting concerns" are shared ones like auth and logging.

items.question: Trong câu "The single entry point that applies cross-cutting concerns so services don't each reimplement them.", từ "cross-cutting" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The single entry point that applies cross-cutting concerns so services don't each reimplement them.", what does "cross-cutting" (adjective) mean?
options: áp dụng xuyên suốt nhiều phần
items.explanation: cross-cutting /ˌkrɒsˈkʌt.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): áp dụng xuyên suốt nhiều phần. "Cross-cutting" = trải rộng qua nhiều module/service, ví dụ xác thực, rate limit, logging.
items.explanationEn: cross-cutting /ˌkrɒsˈkʌt.ɪŋ/ (adjective): spanning many parts. "Cross-cutting" means spanning many modules or services, e.g. authentication, rate limiting, logging.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep it thin — business logic in the gateway creates a bottleneck every team must change.", từ "thin" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep it thin — business logic in the gateway creates a bottleneck every team must change.", what does "thin" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: thin /θɪn/ (tính từ): mỏng nhẹ, ít logic. "Thin gateway/thin client" = chỉ làm ít việc, không chứa logic nghiệp vụ; ngược lại là "fat/thick".
items.explanationEn: thin /θɪn/ (adjective): light, with little logic. A "thin gateway" does little work and holds no business logic; the opposite is "fat" or "thick".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep it thin — business logic in the gateway creates a bottleneck every team must change.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep it thin — business logic in the gateway creates a bottleneck every team must change.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. "Create a bottleneck" = tạo điểm nghẽn khiến cả hệ thống hoặc cả tổ chức bị chậm lại.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (noun): a point that slows everything. "Create a bottleneck" means introducing a point that slows the whole system or organisation.

items.question: Trong câu "It is a critical hop: run it redundantly and watch its p99.", từ "redundantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is a critical hop: run it redundantly and watch its p99.", what does "redundantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: redundantly /rɪˈdʌn.dənt.li/ (trạng từ): có dự phòng nhiều bản. "Run it redundantly" = chạy nhiều bản để một bản hỏng vẫn hoạt động; redundant thường ngày còn nghĩa "thừa".
items.explanationEn: redundantly /rɪˈdʌn.dənt.li/ (adverb): with backup copies. "Run it redundantly" means running several copies so one failure is survivable; redundant also means "unneeded".

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", từ "throttle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", what does "throttle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: throttle /ˈθrɒt.əl/ (động từ): bóp, hạn chế lưu lượng. "Throttle requests" = giới hạn số request được xử lý mỗi giây; danh từ: throttling.
items.explanationEn: throttle /ˈθrɒt.əl/ (verb): to limit the rate of. "Throttle requests" means limiting how many are handled per second; noun: throttling.

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", từ "burst" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", what does "burst" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: burst /bɜːst/ (danh từ): đợt tăng vọt ngắn. "A 5,000 burst" = cho phép vọt lên tối đa 5.000 request trong thời gian ngắn.
items.explanationEn: burst /bɜːst/ (noun): a short sudden spike. "A 5,000 burst" allows a short spike of up to 5,000 requests.

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): theo mặc định. "By default" = khi chưa cấu hình gì khác; default còn có nghĩa "vỡ nợ" trong tài chính.
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless changed. "By default" means when nothing else is configured; in finance, default means failing to repay.

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS, Amazon API Gateway throttles by default at 10,000 requests/s with a 5,000 burst per account per Region; alternatives include Kong, Envoy-based gateways and Apigee.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɒlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): lựa chọn thay thế. "Alternatives include X" = các lựa chọn khác gồm X; "an alternative to Y" = thứ thay cho Y.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɒlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another option. "Alternatives include X" lists other options; "an alternative to Y" is something used instead of Y.

items.question: Trong câu "OAuth 2.0 delegates authorization by issuing access tokens.", từ "delegate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OAuth 2.0 delegates authorization by issuing access tokens.", what does "delegate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): ủy quyền, giao quyền. "Delegated authorization" = người dùng ủy quyền cho app truy cập thay mình mà không đưa mật khẩu.
items.explanationEn: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to hand authority to another. "Delegated authorization" lets a user grant an app access without sharing their password.

items.question: Trong câu "OAuth 2.0 delegates authorization by issuing access tokens.", từ "issue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OAuth 2.0 delegates authorization by issuing access tokens.", what does "issue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: issue /ˈɪʃ.uː/ (động từ): cấp phát, phát hành. "Issue a token" = cấp token; danh từ issue lại thường là "vấn đề" (GitHub issue). Liên quan: issuer (iss).
items.explanationEn: issue /ˈɪʃ.uː/ (verb): to officially give out. "Issue a token" means to give one out; the noun issue usually means a problem. Related: issuer (iss).

items.question: Trong câu "OIDC adds authentication: an ID token describing the user, addressed to the client app.", từ "address" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OIDC adds authentication: an ID token describing the user, addressed to the client app.", what does "address" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (động từ): gửi đến, dành cho. "Addressed to the client" = được dành cho client (aud); "address an issue" lại là giải quyết vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (verb): to direct to a recipient. "Addressed to the client" means intended for the client (aud); "address an issue" means to deal with it.

items.question: Trong câu "PKCE makes a stolen code useless without the verifier; state blocks CSRF.", từ "steal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PKCE makes a stolen code useless without the verifier; state blocks CSRF.", what does "steal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: steal /stiːl/ (động từ): đánh cắp. "A stolen code" = mã bị đánh cắp (steal – stole – stolen); PKCE làm mã đó vô dụng.
items.explanationEn: steal /stiːl/ (verb): to take without permission. "A stolen code" is one taken by an attacker (steal – stole – stolen); PKCE makes it useless.

items.question: Trong câu "Scopes are coarse (orders:read);", từ "coarse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scopes are coarse (orders:read);", what does "coarse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: coarse /kɔːs/ (tính từ): thô, ở mức tổng quát. "Coarse-grained" = phân quyền ở mức rộng; ngược lại là "fine-grained" (chi tiết từng đối tượng).
items.explanationEn: coarse /kɔːs/ (adjective): broad, not detailed. "Coarse-grained" means broad permissions; the opposite is "fine-grained", checked per object.

items.question: Trong câu "A JWT is header.payload.signature in base64url — signed, not encrypted; anyone can read it.", từ "encrypt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A JWT is header.payload.signature in base64url — signed, not encrypted; anyone can read it.", what does "encrypt" (verb) mean?
options: mã hóa để giữ bí mật
items.explanation: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (động từ): mã hóa để giữ bí mật. "Signed, not encrypted" = JWT được ký để chống sửa đổi nhưng không mã hóa, ai cũng đọc được.
items.explanationEn: encrypt /ɪnˈkrɪpt/ (verb): to scramble data secretly. "Signed, not encrypted" means a JWT resists tampering but anyone can read its contents.

items.question: Trong câu "Block algorithm confusion: an attacker changes RS256 to HS256", từ "confusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Block algorithm confusion: an attacker changes RS256 to HS256", what does "confusion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: mixing one thing up with another
items.explanation: confusion /kənˈfjuː.ʒən/ (danh từ): sự nhầm lẫn. "Algorithm confusion" = lừa server dùng nhầm thuật toán (RS256 thành HS256) khi xác minh chữ ký.
items.explanationEn: confusion /kənˈfjuː.ʒən/ (noun): mixing one thing up with another. "Algorithm confusion" tricks a server into verifying with the wrong algorithm (RS256 as HS256).

items.question: Trong câu "exp, iss and aud — a token minted for another API must fail.", từ "mint" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "exp, iss and aud — a token minted for another API must fail.", what does "mint" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mint /mɪnt/ (động từ): tạo ra, phát hành. "A token minted for another API" = token được tạo cho API khác; nghĩa gốc là "đúc tiền".
items.explanationEn: mint /mɪnt/ (verb): to create and issue. "A token minted for another API" was created for a different API; literally, to make coins.

items.question: Trong câu "Keys from the IdP's JWKS by kid, cached and refreshed on rotation.", từ "rotation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keys from the IdP's JWKS by kid, cached and refreshed on rotation.", what does "rotation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rotation /rəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc thay khóa định kỳ. "Key rotation" = định kỳ thay khóa ký mới; "on-call rotation" lại là lịch trực luân phiên.
items.explanationEn: rotation /rəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): replacing keys regularly. "Key rotation" means replacing signing keys periodically; an "on-call rotation" is a duty schedule.

items.question: Trong câu "When instant revocation matters, use opaque tokens + introspection (RFC 7662), cached briefly at the gateway.", từ "revocation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When instant revocation matters, use opaque tokens + introspection (RFC 7662), cached briefly at the gateway.", what does "revocation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: revocation /ˌrev.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thu hồi hiệu lực. "Token revocation" = thu hồi token trước khi hết hạn; động từ: revoke.
items.explanationEn: revocation /ˌrev.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): cancelling validity. "Token revocation" cancels a token before it expires; verb: revoke.

items.question: Trong câu "When instant revocation matters, use opaque tokens + introspection (RFC 7662), cached briefly at the gateway.", từ "instant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When instant revocation matters, use opaque tokens + introspection (RFC 7662), cached briefly at the gateway.", what does "instant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: instant /ˈɪn.stənt/ (tính từ): tức thì. "Instant revocation" = thu hồi có hiệu lực ngay; "instant noodles" = mì ăn liền.
items.explanationEn: instant /ˈɪn.stənt/ (adjective): happening immediately. "Instant revocation" takes effect immediately; compare "instant noodles".

items.question: Trong câu "When instant revocation matters, use opaque tokens + introspection (RFC 7662), cached briefly at the gateway.", từ "briefly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When instant revocation matters, use opaque tokens + introspection (RFC 7662), cached briefly at the gateway.", what does "briefly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: briefly /ˈbriːf.li/ (trạng từ): trong thời gian ngắn. "Cached briefly" = lưu cache trong thời gian ngắn; "briefly explain" lại là giải thích ngắn gọn.
items.explanationEn: briefly /ˈbriːf.li/ (adverb): for a short time. "Cached briefly" means cached for a short time; "briefly explain" means in a few words.

items.question: Trong câu "Rate limits protect capacity and fairness.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rate limits protect capacity and fairness.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng chịu tải tối đa
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng chịu tải tối đa. "Protect capacity" = bảo vệ sức chứa/tài nguyên hệ thống khỏi quá tải; "in my capacity as" = với tư cách.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): the maximum load handled. "Protect capacity" means guarding system resources from overload; "in my capacity as" means in my role as.

items.question: Trong câu "Rate limits protect capacity and fairness.", từ "fairness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rate limits protect capacity and fairness.", what does "fairness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fairness /ˈfeə.nəs/ (danh từ): sự công bằng. Rate limit đảm bảo "fairness": một khách hàng không chiếm hết tài nguyên của người khác.
items.explanationEn: fairness /ˈfeə.nəs/ (noun): equal treatment. Rate limits ensure fairness: one customer cannot use up everyone else's resources.

items.question: Trong câu "Key them by API key, user or tenant — not only IP, since NAT hides whole offices behind one address.", từ "tenant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Key them by API key, user or tenant — not only IP, since NAT hides whole offices behind one address.", what does "tenant" (noun) mean?
options: khách hàng dùng chung hệ thống
items.explanation: tenant /ˈten.ənt/ (danh từ): khách hàng dùng chung hệ thống. "Multi-tenant" = nhiều khách hàng (tenant) dùng chung hạ tầng; nghĩa gốc là "người thuê nhà".
items.explanationEn: tenant /ˈten.ənt/ (noun): a customer sharing a platform. "Multi-tenant" means many customers share one platform; literally, a tenant rents a home.

items.question: Trong câu "In a cluster the counter lives in a shared store, typically Redis with an atomic Lua script — a separate GET then SET lets races through.", từ "race" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a cluster the counter lives in a shared store, typically Redis with an atomic Lua script — a separate GET then SET lets races through.", what does "race" (noun) mean?
options: tình trạng tranh chấp đồng thời
items.explanation: race /reɪs/ (danh từ): tình trạng tranh chấp đồng thời. "Race condition" = lỗi do hai thao tác chen nhau; "lets races through" = để lọt các tranh chấp đó.
items.explanationEn: race /reɪs/ (noun): a timing conflict between operations. A "race condition" is a bug from overlapping operations; "lets races through" means allowing them.

items.question: Trong câu "The full distributed design is in the system design interview topic.", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The full distributed design is in the system design interview topic.", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪb.juː.tɪd/ (tính từ): phân tán trên nhiều máy. "Distributed system" = hệ thống chạy trên nhiều máy phối hợp với nhau; động từ distribute = phân phối.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪb.juː.tɪd/ (adjective): spread across many machines. A "distributed system" runs across many cooperating machines; the verb distribute means to hand out.

items.question: Trong câu "Validate on every request:", từ "validate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validate on every request:", what does "validate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): kiểm tra tính hợp lệ. "Validate a token" = kiểm tra chữ ký, hạn, người nhận… trước khi tin; danh từ: validation.
items.explanationEn: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to check for correctness. "Validate a token" means checking signature, expiry and audience before trusting it; noun: validation.

items.question: Trong câu "POST is neither safe nor idempotent; PUT and DELETE are idempotent.", từ "neither ... nor" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "POST is neither safe nor idempotent; PUT and DELETE are idempotent.", what does "neither ... nor" (conjunction) mean?
optionsEn: not one and not the other
items.explanation: neither ... nor /ˈnaɪ.ðər … nɔːr/ (liên từ): không… cũng không. "Neither A nor B" phủ định cả hai: POST không an toàn và cũng không idempotent.
items.explanationEn: neither ... nor /ˈnaɪ.ðər … nɔːr/ (conjunction): not one and not the other. "Neither A nor B" denies both: POST is not safe and not idempotent.

items.question: Trong câu "Cursor pagination for large or live data; offset is slow deep and drifts on inserts.", từ "drift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cursor pagination for large or live data; offset is slow deep and drifts on inserts.", what does "drift" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to shift gradually out of place
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (động từ): bị lệch dần. "Offset drifts on inserts" = khi có bản ghi mới chèn vào, vị trí trang bị lệch dần; nghĩa gốc là "trôi dạt".
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (verb): to shift gradually out of place. "Offset drifts on inserts" means page positions shift as new rows arrive; literally, to float along.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose the style by consumer: REST at the edge, gRPC inside, events for deferred work, SSE/WebSocket for push.", từ "deferred" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose the style by consumer: REST at the edge, gRPC inside, events for deferred work, SSE/WebSocket for push.", what does "deferred" (adjective) mean?
options: được hoãn lại xử lý sau
items.explanation: deferred /dɪˈfɜːd/ (tính từ): được hoãn lại xử lý sau. "Deferred work" = việc không cần làm ngay, có thể xử lý bất đồng bộ sau; động từ: defer.
items.explanationEn: deferred /dɪˈfɜːd/ (adjective): postponed until later. "Deferred work" need not happen now and can run asynchronously later; verb: defer.

items.question: Trong câu "A thin API gateway centralises authentication, rate limiting, routing and telemetry.", từ "centralise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A thin API gateway centralises authentication, rate limiting, routing and telemetry.", what does "centralise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to align text in the middle
items.explanation: centralise /ˈsen.trə.laɪz/ (động từ): tập trung về một nơi. "Centralise authentication" = gom xác thực về một điểm (gateway); chính tả Mỹ: centralize.
items.explanationEn: centralise /ˈsen.trə.laɪz/ (verb): to bring into one place. "Centralise authentication" means handling it in one place (the gateway); US spelling: centralize.

items.question: Trong câu "Rate limiting algorithms trade precision, memory and burst tolerance; clustered limits need atomic shared state.", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rate limiting algorithms trade precision, memory and burst tolerance; clustered limits need atomic shared state.", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. "Trade precision for memory" = đánh đổi độ chính xác lấy ít bộ nhớ hơn; tính từ: precise.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness. "Trade precision for memory" means giving up exactness to use less memory; adjective: precise.
